facts.fact: Minister Léon Juste Ibombo announced at a FASUCE extraordinary session that the government will release US$9 million to build 186 basic telecom sites in rural areas.
The government invested about 4 billion FCFA (US$6.5 million) between 2021 and 2023 to connect 150 white zones and 19 schools to the internet, per Agence Ecofin.
